title: Le Creuset Cast Iron Mini Cocotte / Terrine – Size 14 – Made in France 🇫🇷
description:
Authentic Le Creuset enameled cast iron mini cocotte / terrine, made in France.
Perfect for small portions, terrines, pâtés, sauces, or individual oven dishes.
✔️ Cast iron with enamel coating – excellent heat retention
✔️ Stamped “LE CREUSET – MADE IN FRANCE – 14”
✔️ Classic brown exterior with light enamel interior
✔️ Suitable for oven, stovetop, and serving
📏 Approximate dimensions:
Diameter: ~14–15 cm
Width with handles: ~18–19 cm
Height: ~6–7 cm
✔️ Condition: good vintage condition
Signs of use (light marks inside and on the base)
No cracks or structural damage
Fully functional
💡 Ideal for cooking and serving directly at the table
💡 Also great for collectors of vintage Le Creuset pieces
